rows.answer: Pell's Saturday market had also had flat sales for years before it moved, so Pell was where Ardley is now, which makes the same jump more likely.

The hidden assumption is that the two groups of farms had everything else in common over the last five years: same seed, same fertilizer, same irrigation, same weather, so that the cover crops were the only difference. That is the only way the 12 percent versus 3 percent comparison can be pinned on the cover crops.
